notes: SoothToken is a fixed-supply ERC-20 named Sooth Protocol (SOOTH) with 18 decimals. Its argument-free constructor mints all 1,000,000,000 tokens once to msg.sender, the factory on the launch path. Transfers have no fees. It exposes no additional mint, burn, owner, pause, blacklist or upgrade functions. No application contracts or initialization calls are required. The pool pairs SOOTH with IMD; initialPrice records provenance only, and the deployer derives the opening price from initialMarketCapWei and totalSupply.
